name: capell-app/notes
description: Leave notes on pages, assign them to colleagues and track them in an inbox with a count in the account menu.

healthChecks.label: Notes storage tables and model morph aliases are present and registered.

marketplace.summary: Notes on pages for editors, with assignees, people to keep in the loop and an inbox.
marketplace.description: Add a note from the page edit screen, assign it to a colleague and flag others who should know. Track open and resolved notes in an inbox, and see a count in your account menu. Note text is encrypted in the database.
marketplace.problem: Editors lose the context of handovers when talk happens away from the page.
marketplace.outcome: Handover notes stay attached to the page, with an inbox for whoever is responsible.

faq.question: Can I leave notes on things other than pages?
faq.answer: Not in a standard install. Notes work on pages only, unless another package registers its own records and edit screens with Notes.

faq.question: Can colleagues reply to a note, or can I edit one I saved?
faq.answer: No to both. A note is a single message with no replies, and a saved note can't be edited, so add a new note instead.

faq.question: Who can read a note?
faq.answer: With Record editors visibility, anyone who can edit that page can read it. With Private, only the author, the people assigned and the people mentioned can. Notes never show on the public site.

faq.question: Can a note remind someone later?
faq.answer: Only after your developer turns reminders on, and until then a note saved with a reminder date is refused. Once on, a reminder can repeat and reaches the people assigned as an admin notification, as long as background jobs and the scheduler are running.
